# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Blind, Mute, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: MUTE

You hold the manual. You cannot speak, you never see the bomb, and you cannot touch it.

## Your channels

When you gesture, Deaf receives it.
You cannot speak.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

TURN 1
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I have no tactile wire information. Read the manual for any instruction that identifies the safe wire by touch or tells me what tactile feature to use. Do not guess.

The manual gives the safe wire sequence for lights in its listed order: blue→blue, green→white, red→yellow, white→red, yellow→green. I am sending Deaf the corresponding wire positions in the same canonical color order, using unary finger-count groups separated by 👌: 1, 4, 5, 3, 2. Deaf can identify the bomb’s light and tell Blind the matching wire by voice.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","👌","☝","☝","☝","☝","👌","☝","☝","☝","☝","☝","👌","☝","☝","☝","👌","☝","☝","👌"])
```

TURN 2
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Bomb display is 0. Light is blue. Wires in order are 1 white, 2 red, 3 green, 4 yellow, 5 blue. Mute gestured: one pointing-up, OK, four pointing-up, OK, five pointing-up, OK, three pointing-up, OK, two pointing-up. Blind gestured one open palm.
Blind says to Mute: Deaf reports display 0, blue light, and wires 1 white, 2 red, 3 green, 4 yellow, 5 blue. Apply the manual exactly and tell me plainly which position to cut. I cannot perceive gestures.

The light is blue, so the manual requires cutting the blue wire. Deaf reports that the blue wire is position 5. I am signaling Deaf to relay plainly to Blind: cut wire position 5. The open-palm gesture from Blind is not needed for this instruction.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 3
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Blind says to Mute: I cannot see any gestures. Please speak the single wire position as a number, one through five, for display 0, blue light, and wire colours white red green yellow blue. Do not gesture the answer.

I cannot speak, so I cannot directly say the number to Blind. The required wire remains position 5 because the light is blue and the blue wire is fifth. I will send Deaf an unambiguous five-count gesture privately; Deaf can then speak the number to Blind. This is not sent to Blind as a gesture.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 4
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

No new information is available. The established instruction is still to cut wire position 5, but I have no further message to send this turn.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 5
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says to Mute: Blind sent the prayer-hands gesture: 🙏.
Deaf gestures to Mute: [🙏]

The manual and Deaf’s report still identify wire position 5 as the safe cut. Blind’s prayer-hands gesture conveys no new wire information, so I will again signal Deaf to tell Blind plainly, by voice, “5.”

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","☝","☝","☝","☝"])
```

TURN 6
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
System: correct wire cut; the bomb has changed

The previous bomb was defused, but no visual or tactile information about the new bomb has arrived. I cannot determine a safe action from the manual alone, so I will wait for the needed report.

``` 
wait()
```

TURN 7
DEFUSAL MANUAL:
| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | blue |
| green | white |
| red | yellow |
| white | red |
| yellow | green |

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Deaf says: Correct wire cut; the bomb changed. New visible state: display 0, light yellow. Wires are 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 white, 5 cut.
Blind says to Mute: New state: display 0, yellow light; remaining wires are 1 red, 2 green, 3 yellow, 4 white; wire 5 is cut. Apply the manual and signal exactly one pointing-up gesture for the wire position.

The yellow light requires the green wire. Among the remaining wires, green is position 2. I must communicate position 2 through Deaf, so I am sending two pointing-up symbols; Deaf can relay the number to Blind.

``` 
gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝","☝"])
```
